card.name: Punctuation after a heading or list term
card.fires_on: Punctuation (comma, open bracket, open parenthesis, 'and') that follows a short heading or list item and comes right before the next item or a reference. Seen after medical condition headings, list items, and logic-formula predicate names.

modes.label: After condition heading
modes.description: A comma or bracket follows a short adverse-reaction or disease heading, before a cross-reference or description.

modes.label: Inside a list of items
modes.description: A comma or 'and' separates items in a series of nouns or verbs.

modes.label: Formula opening
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or question mark starts a predicate in a logic-style formula.

card.plain: It fires on the comma or bracket that comes after a short heading or list item, just before the next item.
